Main roz-e-Qiyaamat ki qasam khaata hoon
Aur buraaiyon par malaamat karne waale nafs ki qasam khaata hoon
Kya ye insaan ye khayaal karta hai ke hum is ki haddiyon ko jama na kar sakenge
Yaqeenan hum is baat par qaadir hain ke is ki ungliyon ke por tak durust kar sakein
Balke insaan ye chaahta hai ke apne saamne buraai karta chala jaaye
Woh ye poochhta hai ke ye Qiyaamat kab aane waali hai
To jab aankhein chaka-chaundh ho jaayengi
Aur chaand ko gehan lag jaaega
Aur ye chaand sooraj ikattha kar diye jaayenge
Us din insaan kahega ke ab bhaagne ka raasta kidhar hai
Hargiz nahin, ab koi thikaana nahin hai
Ab sab ka markaz tumhaare Parwardigar ki taraf hai
Us din insaan ko bataaya jaaega ke us ne pehle aur baad kya kya aamaal kiye hain
Balke insaan khud bhi apne nafs ke haalaat se khoob ba-khabar hai
Chaahe woh kitne hi uzr kyun na pesh kare
Dekhiye, aap Qur'an ki tilaawat mein ujlat ke saath zabaan ko harkat na dein
Ye hamaari zimmedaari hai ke hum ise jama karein aur padhwaayen
Phir jab hum padhwa dein to aap is ki tilaawat ko dohraayen
Phir is ke baad is ki wazaahat karna bhi hamaari hi zimmedaari hai
Nahin, balke tum log duniya ko dost rakhte ho
Aur aakhirat ko nazar-andaaz kiye hue ho
Us din baaz chehre shaadaab honge
Apne Parwardigar ki ne'maton par nazar rakhe hue honge
Aur baaz chehre afsurda honge
Jinhein ye khayaal hoga ke kab kamar-tod museebat waarid ho jaaye
Hoshiyaar! Jab jaan gardan tak pahunch jaaegi
Aur kaha jaaega ke ab kaun jhaad-phoonk karne waala hai
Aur marne waale ko khayaal hoga ke ab sab se judaai hai
Aur pindli pindli se lipat jaaegi
Aaj sab ko Parwardigar ki taraf le jaaya jaaega
Us ne na kalaam-e-Khuda ki tasdeeq ki aur na namaaz padhi
Balke takzeeb ki aur munh pher liya
Phir apne ahl ki taraf akadta hua gaya
Afsos hai tere haal par, bahut afsos hai
Haif hai aur sad haif hai
Kya insaan ka khayaal ye hai ke use isi tarah aazaad chhod diya jaaega
Kya woh us mani ka qatra nahin tha jise rehm mein daala jaata hai
Phir alaqa bana, phir use khalq kar ke baraabar kiya
Phir us se aurat aur mard ka joda tayyaar kiya
Kya woh Khuda is baat par qaadir nahin hai ke murdon ko dobaara zinda kar sake
